title: How to update module firmware safely on S7-1500
description: We need to update the firmware of I/O modules. What is the correct procedure and how do we verify it succeeded?
expected_answer_points: the CPU display shows STOP - FW UPDATE during the update
remove the SIMATIC memory card after the firmware update completes
verify the update via STEP 7, the SIMATIC Automation Tool, or the web server
analog modules require a 24 V DC load supply during the update

title: Replacing an I/O module and its front connector coding
description: We are replacing a digital I/O module. How do we handle the mechanical coding element and the existing front connector?
expected_answer_points: for a new I/O module break out the mechanical coding element half
insert the existing front connector into the new module until it clicks
for fail-safe F-modules transfer the electronic coding element to the new front connector

title: Startup inhibit due to hardware configuration inconsistent
description: After a hardware change the CPU will not enter RUN and reports a hardware configuration mismatch. The physical module revision differs from the project.
expected_answer_points: the expected configuration and actual configuration deviate
the Startup CPU only if compatible setting blocks startup on mismatch
changing to Startup CPU even if mismatch allows startup despite the difference
download the corrected hardware configuration to the CPU

title: How to perform a CPU memory reset
description: We need to perform a memory reset on the CPU using the mode selector. What are the steps and what happens to the data?
expected_answer_points: perform the memory reset using the mode selector
the CPU is initialized with the loaded project data from load memory

title: Power supply SF LED flashing and modules switched off
description: The system power supply SF LED is flashing and modules to the right are not working. What is the cause and remedy?
expected_answer_points: an overload in a power segment makes the red SF LED flash on the power supply
modules to the right of the power supply may be switched off
switch the supply voltage power off and on again after correcting the configuration

title: Interface module secure boot reports invalid signature
description: After a firmware operation the interface module shows RUN, ERROR and MAINT LEDs flashing. What does this mean?
expected_answer_points: an invalid Secure Boot signature causes RUN, ERROR and MAINT LEDs to flash
the interface module must be replaced in this case
verify firmware integrity by comparing the hash of the downloaded file

title: Configuring the CPU startup behavior
description: How do we configure what the CPU does at startup after POWER ON, including behavior on a module mismatch?
expected_answer_points: set the startup type after POWER ON in the CPU Startup properties
the CPU processes the startup OBs during startup
the CPU reaches RUN when the I/O is ready within the parameter assignment time

title: CPU operating mode transitions STARTUP to RUN
description: Explain the operating mode transitions of the CPU from STOP through STARTUP to RUN.
expected_answer_points: the CPU transitions STOP to STARTUP when set to RUN
the CPU goes from STARTUP to RUN once initialization completes
